user_visual_review.clothing_body_static_observation: No obvious clothing-to-body or clothing-to-clothing penetration was found in the published static review.
user_visual_review.hair_headwear_observation: Some hairstyles can intersect head wraps, hoods, high collars, or other head-adjacent garment geometry.

deferred_policy.temporary_rule: Record hair/headwear intersections separately from garment-body failures. Do not modify source assets during the current end-to-end pipeline smoke.
planned_resolution: select only compatible compact or hat-safe HairStyleSets
hide scalp hair for full head covers when no compatible style exists
register dedicated variants only where replacement or hiding is insufficient

notes: This decision accepts only the published static garment/body evidence.
It does not approve motion compatibility, all slot combinations, all ten BodyFits, UE runtime switching, or final production use.
The motions used by the next gate are diagnostic loads and do not constitute the production animation pool.
